leads.posting: RapidCanvas raises $29 Mn in Series B round led by Vertex Ventures. AI startup RapidCanvas has raised $29 million in a Series B funding round led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India, with participation from Hitachi Ventures and existing investors Accel, Peak XV Partners, Valley Capital Partners and Titanium Ventures. The latest round takes the company’s total funding to $52.5 million. The company will use the proceeds to expand its go to market teams, strengthen partnerships and grow its field AI engineering team across India, the US and Brazil. Founded in 2021, RapidCanvas provides an AI platform that combines AI agents with human expertise to help enterprises build and deploy custom AI applications. Its platform aims to help businesses move AI projects from pilots to production. The company said its annual recurring revenue grew 8x over the past six quarters. More than 40% of its customers now run multiple AI use cases in production. In 2026, over 75 enterprises across manufacturing, financial services, retail, business services and infrastructure made 1.4 million AI led decisions using applications built on its platform. RapidCanvas offers three core products: Enterprise Context Engine, Visual Development Canvas and Operational Harness. These products help enterprises capture business context, develop custom AI applications and manage deployed AI solutions. The company targets enterprises with annual revenue of $100 million to $10 billion that have AI budgets but lack the resources or expertise to deploy custom AI applications. Its model combines an AI platform with field engineers who work with customers to build applications and oversee their outcomes after deployment. In December 2024, RapidCanvas raised $16 million in a Series A funding round led by Peak XV Partners, with participation from Titanium Ventures, Accel and Valley Capital Partners. leads.posting: Construction robotics startup Origin raises $20 Mn led by Accel, Zacua Ventures. Origin, a physical AI startup building robots for interior construction, has raised $20 million in total funding in a round co-led by Accel and Zacua Ventures. The round also saw participation from Unilazer Ventures, Schema Ventures and Z21, along with angel investors from Anduril, Skild AI, 1X and Tesla. The company will use the funds to expand its robot fleet, deploy its flagship robot OG-1 and conduct customer pilots in the US and Europe. It also plans to expand its robotics platform to additional interior construction tasks. Founded in 2025 by Yogesh Ghaturle, Ashish Daga and Tushar Makkar, Origin develops robots designed to automate interior construction work. Its flagship robot, OG-1, currently handles wall finishing tasks such as applying compound, sanding and priming walls. The robot is designed to operate across commercial spaces, residential apartments, data centres, hotels and warehouses. The company said it deployed its first robots at construction sites in New York within 10 months of its founding. Origin is preparing for pilots with customers in the US and Europe, including two large drywall finishing contractors in the US. It also plans to conduct pilots in Germany, Sweden, France and Saudi Arabia. The startup's robots are powered by its Construction Action Model, a foundation model developed for construction workflows. The system combines task planning, autonomous navigation and tool control to help robots perform construction tasks and adapt to changing site conditions. Origin plans to expand OG-1's capabilities to tasks such as taping, drywall installation, drilling and conduit installation. The company is targeting the deployment of 150 robots by the end of 2027. The funding comes amid rising interest in construction robotics as companies look to address labour shortages and improve productivity. leads.posting: Z47 leads $12.5 Mn Series A round in Confido Health. Healthtech startup Confido Health has raised $12.5 million in a Series A funding round led by Z47, with participation from existing investors Together Fund and Blume Ventures. The round follows a $10 million Series A round announced in September. The startup had previously raised $3 million in a seed round led by Together Fund in December 2024. The proceeds will be used to scale its AI platform for healthcare operations, Confido Health said in a press release. Founded in 2022 by Chetan Reddy and Vichar Shroff, Confido Health develops AI agents to manage tasks such as appointment scheduling, insurance verification and care coordination. The agents integrate with existing healthcare systems through no-code deployment, with the company claiming a setup time of less than five minutes. Confido Health said its platform integrates with more than 50 systems, including electronic health records, practice management, phone, billing and fax systems, without requiring healthcare providers to change their existing technology stack. The company said it operates across more than 1,500 care sites, primarily independent practice groups, in 27 states and serves around 3,200 providers. It added that one in 50 patients can now access their healthcare providers through its AI agents. The platform uses patient details, referral information and payer requirements collected during intake to manage subsequent tasks such as outreach and scheduling. According to the company, this allows a single interaction to trigger multiple workflows, including referrals, appointments, prescription refills and payments. Confido Health said it has recorded 15x growth since its previous funding round and achieved AI handle rates of more than 95% across key end-to-end office workflows. leads.posting: Team size: 15. Automated e2e screenshot testing without writing or maintaining tests Meticulous is a tool to automatically catch UI bugs in your web application with zero-effort. Install our JavaScript snippet onto production or staging and dev environments, which records user sessions by collecting clickstream and network data. When you post a pull request, Meticulous selects a subset of sessions which are relevant and simulates these against the frontend of your application. Meticulous takes screenshots at key points and detects any visual differences. It posts those diffs in a comment for you to inspect in a few seconds. This eliminates the setup and maintenance burden of UI testing. Developer Tools, Hard Tech, SaaS, B2B, Engineering, Product and Design, United Kingdom, Europe
